items.title: Chivalry
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Take it back to Medieval times and pick up a sword and shield with this skin pack of knights and warriors. Whether you fancy a lance, sword, or halberd, all you need to do is suit up.

- Includes 10 armored skins
- A variety of class-based options to choose from
- By Drzzter & Pathway Studios

items.title: Creepy Crazy
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Watch out for the creepy things that lurk in the dark, or become a creepy thing that lurks in the dark and scare others! These skins are super scary! If you are a fan of all things horror then these skins are perfect for you!

- 12 creepy horror skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Dance Music Teens
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Nothing is better than dancing to your favorite music! These teens love to blast music and dance the night away! What is your favorite type of music? I can't imagine a world without music!

- 13 dancer skins

items.title: DEMON MOBS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Demon mobs are scary! These used to be just mobs but now they have all turned to scary demons. Choose any of these DEMON MOBS for your next adventure!

+ Perfect for demon mob role-playing
+ Horror
+ Includes 13 scary demon mob skins
+ Scary

DEMON MOBS by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Mob Skins
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Want to look like a stylish mob in Minecraft? This pack is perfect for you!

- Animals
- Cute
- Great for roleplay

by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Ice Cream Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
I scream. You scream. We all scream for ice cream!
- 12 roleplay skins!
- Modern attire inspired by the color white!

items.title: Modern Teen Style
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A modern teen needs some fresh new clothes on their skins. Pick up some awesome cool, cute, and fashionable attire in this pack. With great city life, athletic, comfy attire, Modern Teen Style will have your next favorite skin!

+ Perfect for teens
+ Modern and colorful designs
+ 1 free skin!

items.title: Advanced Armor HD
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
'Advanced Armor HD' is the ultimate pack. With 12 HD skins, each with their own unique style and color, feel free to show off your awesome skills in any game mode. These aesthetic skins will make you look super cool playing with your friends!

- Modern armor designs
- Perfect for teens
- Cool skins

items.title: SCP Quarantined
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
A new cell of SCP experiments are currently under strict quarantine. Contained for now, these 13 skins await their next escape. 
SCP-079, SCP-1730, SCP-1936, SCP-2006, SCP-2764, SCP-3663, SCP-3700, SCP-387, SCP-682, SCP-6890, SCP-979

CC-BY-SA

items.title: SCP Mobs
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
SCP entities have escaped and now possess the bodies of mobs. Be on high alert for these shapeshifters among us. No one can be trusted. 11 SCP mob skins include Creeper SCP-173, Slime SCP-999, Ghast SCP-3008, Evoker SCP-049, Ender Dr. Bright and more!

CC-BY-SA

items.title: Skins of the Month - April
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Flowers are in full bloom, the birds are chirping, and the bunnies are out to play! Rain or shine, nature, fashion, or farm life, find a skin styled for every Springtime occasion. Get into season with these 14 April-themed skins!

items.title: Samurai vs Ogre Castle Assault
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
This world is full of ogres! Gear up with cool Japanese armor and become a brave samurai! Defeat the King Ogre and save the world!

-Playable solo or with up to 4 friends.
-13 new enemy mobs
-5 new armor designs
-6 new swords designs
-Fight ogre mobs in this Japanese style adventure

- Built by Mononof Studio
- Developer: Impress

items.title: Treasure Valley
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The greatest treasures are those invisible to the eye but found by the heart. Are you brave enough to follow your destiny and find the long-lost treasures? Explore the Treasure Valley and find out yourself!

- Stunning survival spawn
- Includes hidden treasures
- By RareLoot

items.title: New Look Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The New Look Teens have arrived to renew fashion, with the most beautiful and original style, you will have a unique style.

-12 Skins
-by UnderBlocks

items.title: Sheep Dogs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Woof! Uh, we mean baaaaa. Roleplay as one of these super-color sheepdogs!

- Six hand-crafted HD skins! Available in black, blue, green, orange, pink, and white!
- One skin free
- By 57Digital

items.title: Banana Heroes
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Be a hero... a banana hero! Dress up on your next crazy adventure as one of these cute fruit-inspired Banana Hero skins!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Bear Explorers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Explore the ground outdoors as one of these adventurous bear skins! Which style will you pick?

- 6 hand-crafted HD skins
- Includes classy, desert, jungle, polar, scarf, and tough explorer!
- One free skin included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Something's Fishy
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Ever wondered what it might look like if you had fish for hands, or fish for feet? Well... wonder no more! Something's Fishy has you covered.

- Hand-crafted weird-and-wonderful HD skins
- One skin free (Fish Legs)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Grim Creepers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Showcase your love of the iconic creeper with this skin pack of Grim Creepers!

- 10 colors to choose from
- 1 skin free!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Alien Infiltrators
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
*cough* Nothing to see here. *cough* Just a city overtaken by alien folk. Eeek! Will you join them on their quest for world domination?

+ Includes 10 skins
+ One skin free
+ Includes artist, cop, shopkeeper, teacher, zookeeper, chef, firefighter, builder, rockstar, and scientist!
+ By 57Digital

items.title: Woodland Elves
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
These elves know the woodlands better than anyone - don't wander too deep into the woods without these skins! 

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Remotes
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Celebrate the gadget you probably use every day without even thinking! Roleplay on your next adventure as a remote control!

- Includes Curvy Remote, Minimal Remote, Retro Remote, Smart Remote, Classic Remote, and Watch Remote!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Vintage Mechanics
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Roleplay as a vintage mechanic with this cute collection of skins!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Anime Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Show all your friends your cool skins with, Anime Demons! Includes 10 unique skins!

- Anime demon-themed skins!
- Great for roleplaying!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.
